Update: Hi! In celebration of Chapter 3 getting released this Sunday, I'm releasing Chapter 2 in full. Chapter 3 is 50 pages at the moment and coming in hot! I've already got Chapter 4 written and I'm almost done with the images for that chapter. Chapter 5 is when the gender change occurs for those wondering, but it's hinted at throughout.

The story is blocked through the end, and I've written all the text through chapter 4 with major story beats finished up through Chapter 6. Chapter 6 is spicy spicy spicy. Chapter 7 is still being written but the story beats are mostly fleshed out.

I've learned a lot over these last 4 comics, and hope that the new style continues to evolve to tell a compelling story. Please let me know your thoughts!

Please continue to support me at Patreon @ Bartoon. Here's the schedule for the rest of Feb:
Feb 7: Recurve Chapter 3 (Comic)
Feb 8: The Many Adventures of Captain Billie O'Tea (Web novel game) Prologue
Feb 14: Recurve Valentines day episode (Bonus)
Feb 15: Runaway Prince Ch 1
Feb 22: Recurve Ch 4: Intercepted
Feb 28: The Many Adventures of Captain Billie O'Tea (Web novel game) Part 1

-----------------------------------------------------------

Hey All, welcome to Bartoon's Recurve! This is a future world where plastic poisoning has caused the population to become 90% men. After a global war, a pacification and new government establishment, science created a medical breakthrough! They could fix the population imbalance! The plan is to roll-out to the entire world, but first, they need to propogandize everyone. And the gov found their representative in Layton/Laysee!

I present Chapter 2: Champions. Layton and his team have won the championship and are celebrating the way they do! Establishing the team dynamics. They love Layton. He's on the beginning of a generational performance. A nearly flawless season as a rookie QB. His team has rallied behind him and encourages him to keep trucking along. They're in it with him for the long haul! All except one second string quarterback... who's scheming has begun.

Artists Notes: I've decided to pull a bit more from chapter 3, into this chapter. There's no story change, just more images for this chapter (over 50 as opposed to the 20 that I planned for). The full story is over 50 pages on my Patreon!!!

Let me know what you think of the recent improvements. I've almost got a good flow down, but as we keep going, it'll be nice to improve. Let me know what I could or should do to make this a better story. Thank you so much for your support!

Edit: increased the resolution to 2k... but I realize why the resolution is still low on computer monitors. The panels themselves are still small and they're showing up very large on computer monitors. For the next project I'll be increasing the panel resolution themselves to fix this. Sorry for the inconvenience guys.
